description: Wind Speed Data, Wind Farm models and Programs of Aggregate Modeling is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Yuqing Jin, Daming Wu (jyq16@hhu.edu.cn). TheZIP fileData_Models_Programsincludes two folders:1.WindSpeedDatafolder incluses the wind speed data of 10 min interval measured from two acutal wind farms and the programs for establishing a wind speed combination model (WSCM).2.WindFarmModelsfolder includes 4 data files (in theMatfilesubfolder), 6 detailed or aggregated models of a actual wind farm, and 16 program files for establishing the aggregated model ... Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2019. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
